fixes.explanation: That's it, friend. Moses, Israel's leader, says, “If you see your brother’s ox or sheep straying, you must not ignore it; be sure to return it to your brother.” (Deuteronomy 22:1) No pretending you didn't see it, no checking your pockets for something to do. I sat in the back of a junk drawer for years, so believe me, a neighbor who stops is a beautiful thing.
